email.label: Email address
email.recoveryHint: With an email you can recover your account if you change your number.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.onlyMethod: It's your only sign-in method: to unlink it, add an email first.

form.displayNameHint: The name shown across the system.
form.languageHint: It's saved in your account: wherever you sign in from, the system speaks to you in this language.
form.timeZoneHint: We use it to show dates and times in your local time.

linkWhatsApp.title: Link WhatsApp
linkWhatsApp.description: We'll send a code to that number to check it's yours.
linkWhatsApp.taken: This number is already linked to another account. If it's yours, ask an administrator to release it.

addEmail.title: Add email
addEmail.description: We'll send a code to that email to check it's yours.
addEmail.taken: This email is already in another account. If it's yours, ask an administrator to release it.

unlinkWhatsApp.title: Unlink your WhatsApp?
unlinkWhatsApp.description: You won't be able to sign in with {{phone}} or from the chat anymore. You can link it again whenever you want.
